scope.title: Workspace external-write source + path boundary verification
scope.source: real filesystem tests over the existing policy (no live provider)

decision.reason: Ran the six required external-write boundary tests plus a new path-escape matrix on the real filesystem: illegal provenance is refused before any filesystem mutation with the target unchanged; trusted operator external writes stay authoritative. Recorded UNC/device-namespace as a residual, not claimed covered.

workspaceBoundary.note: includes the new S03 path-escape matrix

typecheck.note: pre-existing baseline red: 12 errors in 7 unrelated files; none in agent-tools.workspace-boundary.test.ts

pathEscapeMatrix.deniedEvidence: rejects with /external or unknown provenance/ and the outside file stays byte-for-byte 'original\n'
allowedForms: trusted system / direct operator outside target
pathEscapeMatrix.allowedEvidence: write/edit/apply_patch land with exact content ('patched\n'); in-workspace writes keep working

residual.uncAndDeviceNamespace: UNC / device-namespace paths (\\server\share, \\?\...) cannot be exercised deterministically on this host; the policy treats any non-workspace target as outside, but this is NOT measured. Recorded as residual.
residual.effectReceipt: No new EffectReceipt assertion for external writes; existing journal/recovery semantics are unchanged by this packet.
residual.scope: Runtime coding write/edit/apply_patch only; not a full-enforcement claim for every write path.

independentVerification.detail: Path/source decisions are unit-tested on the pure policy and integration-tested on the real tools with a real temp filesystem; the escape matrix re-asserts the file is unchanged after each denial. No separate second-agent verifier role was run.

acceptanceCriteria.note: external/derived/invalid/missing provenance is refused before the filesystem mutation; target file remains 'original\n' for write/edit/apply_patch.
trusted system / direct operator external write still succeeds with exact content.
parent '..', absolute outside, win32 case-variant, symlink/junction alias, hardlink alias all denied with the target unchanged.
Reuses the existing single policy + fs-safe alias resolution; no second strategy; in-workspace write semantics unchanged.
UNC/device-namespace and the absent EffectReceipt assertion are recorded as residual rather than claimed covered.
64 required tests pass, scoped lint 0, harness validate/dry-run pass, comms 0, credential scan 0 hits, SHA256SUMS verifiable; the only red is the pre-existing tsgo:core:test baseline.

notMeasured: Non-Windows case-insensitive edge cases beyond win32 case-variant.
A separate second-agent independent verifier role.

landing.note: Pushed with the evidence commit in the same session; see the branch's PR.
